scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared && tsc --noEmit -p backend && tsc --noEmit -p frontend
scripts.deploy:backend: npm run build:backend && bash backend/scripts/build-layers.sh && (test -d backend/layers/sharp/nodejs || { echo 'ERROR: Lambda sharp layer missing after build-layers.sh (backend/layers/ is gitignored)' >&2; exit 1; }) && cd backend && sam deploy
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace shared --if-present && npm run test --workspace backend --if-present && npm run test --workspace frontend
